# Set Respawn Max Time

Source: [wiki article 4433](../archive/4433.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Set Respawn Max Time](../../api/actions/set-respawn-max-time.md).

<a id="wiki-4433-n1"></a>

- Changing respawn max time for an already dead player takes effect at their next death, not the current death.
